# https://www.rebyuu.app/robots.txt
#
# Reviewed 2026-08-24. Re-review whenever a route is added to src/app/App.tsx,
# or when the /browse filter params in BrowsePage.tsx change.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# Default group — applies to every crawler not given its own group below.
# That deliberately includes Googlebot, Bingbot and every AI answer-engine
# crawler: GPTBot, OAI-SearchBot, ChatGPT-User, ClaudeBot, Claude-User,
# Claude-SearchBot, PerplexityBot, Perplexity-User, Google-Extended, CCBot.
#
# Rebyuu wants AI answer-engine citation traffic — an assistant citing and
# linking back to a rebyuu.app page is the same value proposition as an
# organic search referral, so none of those are singled out for a block.
# They are deliberately NOT given their own "Allow: /" group: a crawler
# obeys only the single most specific group that names it, so giving GPTBot
# its own group containing just "Allow: /" would silently exempt it from
# every Disallow below. Leaving them unnamed means they fall through to
# this group and inherit the same rules as everyone else.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: *

# --- The faceted crawl trap -------------------------------------------
# /browse itself is public and worth crawling: it is the catalogue entry
# point and links out to individual title pages.
#
# Its filtered variants are not. BrowsePage.tsx reads seven params from the
# URL — genre, year, season, status, sort, page and q — and every
# combination renders a distinct 200. Treating genre as single-select that
# is ~296,000 URLs; with real multi-genre selection and free-text q it runs
# into the hundreds of millions, all of it near-duplicate reorderings of
# the same catalogue. None of it should consume crawl budget.
#
# "?" is a literal character here, not a wildcard, so "/browse?" matches
# every query-string variant while leaving the bare path untouched. The
# Allow is redundant given that, but states the intent explicitly.
Allow: /browse$
Disallow: /browse?
Disallow: /browse/?

# --- Account and private surfaces -------------------------------------
# No unique content for an anonymous crawler; /profile and /lists are
# behind ProtectedRoute and /admin behind AdminRoute (session + is_admin).
Disallow: /login
Disallow: /profile
Disallow: /lists
Disallow: /admin

# / and /anime/:id (~22k title pages) are intentionally NOT disallowed.
# Only a quality-gated subset is submitted via the XML sitemap, but any
# /anime/:id page reachable through internal links stays crawlable, so
# Google can evaluate and promote one into the submitted tier later
# without needing a robots.txt change.

# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
# ByteDance's crawler. Given its own group and fully blocked: a documented
# history of ignoring crawl-delay and robots directives, and negligible
# answer-engine citation value for this audience compared to the crawlers
# allowed above. Revisit if that changes.
# -----------------------------------------------------------------------
User-agent: Bytespider
Disallow: /

Sitemap: https://www.rebyuu.app/sitemap-index.xml
